mapper.select: select id, name, source_type, version, created_by, updated_at, (plan -> 'bounds' ->> 'w')::float8 as width, (plan -> 'bounds' ->> 'h')::float8 as height, (select count(*) from placement p where p.drawing_id = drawing.id) as placements from drawing order by id
select exists(select 1 from drawing where name = #{name} and id <> #{excludeId})
mapper.insert: insert into drawing (name, source_type, source_file, plan, layer_rules, created_by) values (#{name}, #{sourceType}, '', cast(#{plan} as jsonb), cast(#{layerRules} as jsonb), #{createdBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: update drawing set source_file = #{sourceFile} where id = #{id}
update drawing set name = #{name}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
